details.sql:
WITH quarterly_financials AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    metric,
    value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE 
    calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND ticker IN ('QCOM','NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','AVGO','TXN')
    AND metric IN ('Revenue', 'Gross Profit', 'Operating Income', 'Net Income')
    AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
    AND value IS NOT NULL
),
annual_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM quarterly_financials
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue,
    (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS operating_margin,
    (net_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS net_margin
  FROM annual_aggregates
  WHERE revenue > 0
),
peer_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN gross_margin END) AS peer_avg_gross_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN operating_margin END) AS peer_avg_operating_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN net_margin END) AS peer_avg_net_margin
  FROM margins
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
  m.calendar_year,
  m.ticker,
  m.gross_margin AS company_gross_margin,
  m.operating_margin AS company_operating_margin,
  m.net_margin AS company_net_margin,
  p.peer_avg_gross_margin,
  p.peer_avg_operating_margin,
  p.peer_avg_net_margin
FROM margins m
JOIN peer_averages p ON m.calendar_year = p.calendar_year
WHERE m.ticker = 'QCOM'
ORDER BY m.calendar_year
LIMIT 500

    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    metric,
    value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE

    AND ticker IN ('QCOM','NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','AVGO','TXN')
    AND metric IN ('Revenue', 'Gross Profit', 'Operating Income', 'Net Income')
    AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
    AND value IS NOT NULL
),
annual_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM quarterly_financials
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue,
    (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS operating_margin,

SELECT

  m.net_margin AS company_net_margin,

  p.peer_avg_operating_margin,
  p.peer_avg_net_margin

details.analysis:
TL;DR: Qualcomm’s operating and net margins have trended up from ~23.6%/21.5% in 2023 to ~28.9%/26.3% in 2025 per the SQL results, and the chart/headlines frame this as a constructive margin story versus peers. However, reported peer gross-margin series and the industry median in headlines show some inconsistencies that warrant caution.

Key points:
- SQL: QCOM operating margin rose from 23.61% (2023) → 26.74% (2024) → 28.95% (2025); net margin rose 21.47% → 25.98% → 26.32% over the same years. [SQL]
- Chart/headlines: recent gross margin ~55.7–56.2% (2024 and Q2‑2025), which is well above the semiconductor median ~29.5% and supports higher profitability vs many peers. [1][2][3]
- Peer comparison (SQL): peer average operating/net margins are lower in 2023–24 (operating ~14.6%/19.0%; net ~13.0%/11.4%), implying QCOM outperformance on margins in those years. Note peer averages spike in the 2025 SQL row (operating ~37.1%, net ~32.6%), which changes the gap. [SQL]
- Industry backdrop: strong 2025 end-market tailwinds (AI, data‑center demand) support semiconductor revenue and could sustain high margins, but capex, R&D and supply/geopolitical risks remain headwinds. [Chart summary]

details.sql:
WITH quarterly_financials AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    metric,
    value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE 
    calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND ticker IN ('QCOM','NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','AVGO','TXN')
    AND metric IN ('Revenue', 'Gross Profit', 'Operating Income', 'Net Income')
    AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
    AND value IS NOT NULL
),
annual_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM quarterly_financials
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue,
    (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS operating_margin,
    (net_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS net_margin
  FROM annual_aggregates
  WHERE revenue > 0
),
peer_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN gross_margin END) AS peer_avg_gross_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN operating_margin END) AS peer_avg_operating_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'QCOM' THEN net_margin END) AS peer_avg_net_margin
  FROM margins
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
  m.calendar_year,
  m.ticker,
  m.gross_margin AS company_gross_margin,
  m.operating_margin AS company_operating_margin,
  m.net_margin AS company_net_margin,
  p.peer_avg_gross_margin,
  p.peer_avg_operating_margin,
  p.peer_avg_net_margin
FROM margins m
JOIN peer_averages p ON m.calendar_year = p.calendar_year
WHERE m.ticker = 'QCOM'
ORDER BY m.calendar_year
LIMIT 500
